verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion controls are a fair privacy question for a mobile client to a cloud developer platform with AI features, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents retention settings, deletion of chat or agent data, or account data deletion. The only nearby control is the setting to allow or block suggestions that match public code, which is an adjacent feature and does not count.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
